plan.description: Day-by-day execution plan. One entry per work session, ordered by day_offset ascending. Front-load research, back-load polishing/submission.

day_offset.description: Days from today (0 = today). The largest day_offset must be <= days_remaining - 1 so the deadline day stays free for buffer/submission.

task.description: A concrete, startable task — NOT vague. e.g. 'Read 2 papers from the keyword list and bullet-summarise them', not 'do research'.

hours.description: Estimated focused hours for this single task.

deliverable_link.description: Optional link to a draft/artifact produced by this task; null when there is nothing to link yet.

resources.description: 3-6 relevant resources keyed to the assignment keywords.

url.description: Include a URL ONLY if you are confident it exists; otherwise null. Never invent links.

total_estimated_hours.description: Sum of all plan[].hours. Must stay within +/-20% of the extractor's estimated_hours (Contract B).
